Class ScrollMotion

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.gui.element.internal.ScrollMotion
public final class ScrollMotion extends Object
Screen clamping and the swipe-into-view stop rule.

A gesture that returns false is the end of the scrollable only after an earlier gesture in the same search actually moved it. A false result before any movement means the caller's direction did not move the scrollable, so swipe-into-view tries the opposite direction on that axis. swipeToEndOfView does not use this rule; it stops on the first false in the requested direction.
